PromptRecord__Meta.PromptRecord__Title: Image Cleanup - Composite Safe Sharpen And Upscale
PromptRecord__Meta.PromptRecord__Summary: Sharpens and upscales an existing image with aspect ratio, perspective and camera angle locked and nothing added, so the output still aligns with the other layers of a composite.

PromptRecord__PromptText: ONLY sharpen and make the image higher resolution
DO NOT ADD NEW BUILDING ELEMENTS OR DETAILS THAT ARE NOT THERE
SAME IMAGE PROPORTIONS MUST BE MAINTAINED THIS IS FOR A COMPOSITE SO ACCURACY IS KEY FOR ALIGNMENT WITH OTHER LAYERS

PromptRecord__Usage.PromptRecord__Notes: Held verbatim with no variables. Capitals are deliberate - they are the emphasis the model responds to. Feed the image to be cleaned up alongside this prompt. Check the output against the source layer at the same pixel size before compositing - any drift in crop or proportion breaks alignment.
